ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-17-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Vicki Gross
Petitioner Hung Lien Ly and the father Huy Minh Lieu appeared in proper and was sworn and examined. Thr father of the minor gave his consent to the Change of name.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing. It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: HANNAH LIEU.

Decree signed in open court.
